Definition: properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to leave, permit, forsake, cast off or away, reject, suffer, join, spread out or abroad, be loosed, cease, abandon, quit, hang loose, cast down, make a raid, lie fallow, let fall, forgo, draw; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to leave, let alone, lie fallow, entrust to; 1a2) to forsake, abandon; 1a3) to permit; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be forsaken; 1b2) to be loosened, be loose; 1b3) to be let go, spread abroad; 1c) (Pual) to be abandoned, be deserted
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
